programs.title: Doc Martin
programs.desc: Pauline finds out that the Doc is going to leave Portwenn, and starts a work-to-rule when she receives her somewhat terse reference. Bert organises a baby shower for Louisa. When the Doc goes on a trip to a conference in London with Edith, he finds out what each wants from their relationship - and also that he can deal with blood again.

programs.title: A Touch Of Frost
programs.desc: An unidentified corpse is dragged out of a river. The only clue is a name on a driving licence found on the body, however the owner of the licence is alive and has no connection with the dead man. Frost is intrigued, but distracted by a more dramatic case. The star player of Denton Athletic collapses at a press conference due to overdosing on drugs. Was it a mistake or the deliberate act of an unseen hand?
